preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the binary tree is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
Each element in the array arr[] represents the parent of a node, and the parent can be between 0 and 10^5, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: There is exactly one node with arr[i] = -1
preconditions.description: This node is the root of the binary tree.

postconditions.description: The height of the binary tree is at least 1.
The height of the binary tree is at most N, the total number of nodes.
The height of the binary tree is the maximum depth among all nodes.
